name.zh: 青岛中旻国际贸易有限公司
name.en: Qingdao Zhongmin International Trade Co., Ltd.

slogan.zh: 链接全球贸易，成就品质生活

intro.zh: 青岛中旻国际贸易有限公司坐落于中国重要的沿海开放城市、世界级港口城市——青岛。公司深耕进出口贸易与国内贸易双赛道，依托青岛港的区位优势与成熟的供应链网络，为全球客户提供一站式贸易综合服务。
intro.en: Qingdao Zhongmin International Trade Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Qingdao, a world-class coastal port city and one of China's key hubs for international trade. We operate across both import/export and domestic markets, leveraging the location advantage of Qingdao Port and a mature supply-chain network to deliver one-stop trade services to clients worldwide.

address.zh: 中国山东省青岛市市南区香港中路 XX 号 XX 大厦 XX 层（邮编 266000）
address.en: Floor XX, XX Building, No.XX Hong Kong Middle Road, Shinan District, Qingdao 266000, Shandong, China

subtitle.zh: 进出口 + 国内贸易双轮驱动，一站式供应链服务
subtitle.en: Import / Export + Domestic Trade, One-Stop Supply Chain

subtitle.zh: 六大品类产品，严选货源与质量管控
subtitle.en: Six Product Categories with Rigorous Sourcing & QC

subtitle.zh: 报关、物流、合规、金融全链路赋能

content.zh:
青岛中旻国际贸易有限公司是一家以进出口贸易与国内贸易为核心的综合型贸易企业。我们秉持“诚信、专业、共赢”的经营理念，业务覆盖机电设备、建材五金、农产品食品、化工原料、纺织服装及日用消费品等多个领域。

公司拥有一支具备国际贸易、海关事务、国际物流与供应链管理经验的复合型团队，能够为客户提供从询盘、报价、签约、采购、质检、仓储、报关、海运到结算的全流程服务。我们与国内外众多优质工厂及渠道建立了长期稳定的合作关系，致力于成为客户值得信赖的全球贸易伙伴。
content.en:
Qingdao Zhongmin International Trade Co., Ltd. is a comprehensive trading enterprise focused on both import/export and domestic trade. Guided by the principles of integrity, professionalism and win-win cooperation, our business spans machinery & equipment, building materials & hardware, agricultural & food products, chemicals, textiles & apparel, and consumer goods.

Backed by a multidisciplinary team with expertise in international trade, customs affairs, international logistics and supply-chain management, we provide end-to-end services — from inquiry, quotation and contracting to sourcing, QC, warehousing, customs clearance, ocean freight and settlement. We have built long-term, stable partnerships with quality manufacturers and channels at home and abroad, striving to be our clients' most trusted global trade partner.

title.zh: 中旻国际亮相广交会，斩获多国订单
title.en: Zhongmin Debuts at Canton Fair, Secures Multi-Country Orders

summary.zh: 在第 136 届广交会上，中旻国际展示了六大品类产品，与来自东南亚、中东、欧洲的客商达成多项合作意向。
summary.en: At the 136th Canton Fair, Zhongmin showcased six product categories and reached cooperation intentions with buyers from Southeast Asia, the Middle East and Europe.

content.zh: 第 136 届中国进出口商品交易会（广交会）圆满落幕。中旻国际携机电设备、建材五金、农产品食品等六大品类亮相，凭借稳定的货源与专业的服务团队，吸引了大量海外客商驻足洽谈，现场达成多项合作意向，进一步拓展了全球贸易版图。
content.en: The 136th China Import and Export Fair (Canton Fair) concluded successfully. Zhongmin presented six product categories including machinery, building materials and food products. With stable sourcing and a professional team, the company attracted numerous overseas buyers and reached multiple cooperation intentions, further expanding its global trade footprint.

title.zh: 2026 上半年外贸形势分析与应对策略

summary.zh: 在全球供应链重构背景下，外贸企业应如何降本增效、布局多元市场。
summary.en: How trading companies can cut costs, boost efficiency and diversify markets amid global supply-chain restructuring.

content.zh: 2026 年上半年，全球贸易格局持续演变。建议外贸企业：一是拓展东南亚、中东、拉美等新兴市场以分散风险；二是强化供应链数字化协同，提升交付透明度；三是善用供应链金融工具优化资金效率。中旻国际将持续以专业服务为客户护航。
content.en: In H1 2026, the global trade landscape keeps evolving. We advise trading companies to: diversify into emerging markets such as Southeast Asia, the Middle East and Latin America; strengthen digital supply-chain collaboration for transparency; and leverage supply-chain finance to optimize cash flow. Zhongmin remains committed to serving clients with expertise.

title.zh: 中旻国际上线数字化贸易协同平台
title.en: Zhongmin Launches Digital Trade Collaboration Platform

summary.zh: 客户可在线跟踪订单、物流与结算进度，贸易流程更透明。
summary.en: Clients can now track orders, logistics and settlement online for full transparency.

content.zh: 为提升客户服务体验，中旻国际上线数字化贸易协同平台，客户可实时查看订单状态、物流轨迹与结算进度，实现贸易全流程在线协同与可追溯，让每一笔合作都更安心、更高效。
content.en: To elevate client experience, Zhongmin launched a digital trade collaboration platform where clients can track order status, logistics and settlement in real time — enabling fully traceable, online collaboration across the entire trade process.
